fact: Gabonreview reports that on 28 April 2026 the DGI, CNSS and CNAMGS launched work on the Declaration unique des salaires, in which the NIF for employers and the NIP for employees becomes compulsory, with operation targeted for July 2026.

The amended Digital Gabon financing agreement (effective 2 September 2026) finances digital authentication of social protection beneficiaries' identity and upgrading ID authentication technology for the civil service HR system, both against the RBPP ID system.
